text: Qatar Airways Group is wholly owned by the Government of the State of Qatar.

source.name: Qatar Airways Group Q.C.S.C.: Consolidated financial statements for the year ended 31 March 2026 (note 1, corporate information)
source.quote: The Company is ultimately wholly owned by the Government of the State of Qatar

additionalSources.name: Reuters (Praveen Menon), via Gulf Times: Qatar Airways a fully government-owned entity now
additionalSources.quote: Qatar’s sovereign wealth fund has bought the stakes in its national airline owned by private shareholders, making Qatar Airways a fully government-owned entity
